thread:
sasha: Heads-up: quiet window in 30m for a small runtime kernel tweak that touches the router header path and API schema behavior. will run a short canary, need console header split and router sticky change coordinated.

matt: ETA on the change window?

sasha: starting window at 1768468200 (about 5m from now). canary wave will be 5% traffic -> 20% -> 100% if green.

jun: Is anything pinned? want to avoid accidental rollout of console that expects the new header.

sasha: runtime will be pinned to `runtime-kernel-137` for the wave. console will get a feature flag `hdr-v2` off by default; we’ll flip to on after router canary passes. API will continue to accept v1 for 5 minutes as fallback.

riley: I added a one-line blurb to the release notes: "runtime: kernel-137 optimization (router header path); router: header key migration; console: feature flag for header v2." Link: https://go/release-notes/1768468 (private)

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: runtime -> runtime-kernel-137 canary @1768468200. Steps: canary(5%) -> monitor(10m) -> gradewave(20%) -> 100% if checks pass. Runbooks attached.

ops-runner: Rollback criteria (TL;DR):
- p95 latency increase > 200ms vs baseline in canary window
- error rate (5xx) bump > 0.5 percentage points absolute
- 502/504 increase > 0.2 percentage points
- Console telemetry shows >1% malformed header warnings
If any of the above, stop rollout and revert to previous runtime and router variant.

matt: Quick preflight check commands for oncall during canary:
- `kubectl rollout status deploy/runtime -n prod --watch`
- `kubectl get pods -l app=router -n prod -o wide`
- `curl -I https://api.internal/v2/health` (expect 200, schema-checks on console test harness)

jun: Who owns the final flag flip for console? I'm happy to do it once router is green.

sasha: please do, thanks. tagging @jun to flip `hdr-v2` at 20% wave success. riley to confirm release notes are in the customer-facing doc after full rollout.

riley: will update post-rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary started: runtime runtime-kernel-137 at 1768468200 -> 5% traffic. Monitoring hooks active.

ops-runner: Observability check: p95 currently +12ms, 5xx steady. I'll watch the next 10m and post an update.

matt: thanks — standby for manual stop if we hit the criteria. :thumbsup:

sasha: standing by as release owner. ping here with any anomalies.

ops-runner: 1768468360: canary stable at 5% for 10m, metrics nominal. proceeding to 20% per plan.

matt: acknowledged, advancing. :white_check_mark:
